description: Russia outside the Moscow Reichskommissariat (RKM), generated with the Codex protection engine under the RKM pilot rules (at most three members, same parent/TNO owner/cores; national, owner and historical-front borders, major-city hosts and river boundaries protected), plus the Codex 2026-10-21 v2 dense-country candidates for Shanxi, Shaanxi, Hunan, Guizhou and Guangxi. Groups whose union has a convex-hull fill below 0.4, a minimum-rectangle aspect above 3.5 or an area above 50,000 km2 are left out.
